rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved program types listed in Board rule 297.8(b)(9); most common ACPE. CE earned for PTCB/NHA certification counts if it meets TSBP rules and falls in the renewal period
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial renewal: exempt from most CE, but one HHSC-approved human trafficking course is required.
rules.audit_note: CE compliance verified in CE Broker before renewal; keep certificates 3 years; random audits. National certification no longer exempts from CE.
rules.notes: Registration renews every two years by the last day of the month the original registration was issued.
